hooks.command: DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; PREV=$(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse origin/main@{1} 2>/dev/null); CUR=$(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$PREV" ] && [ "$PREV" != "$CUR" ]; then RANGE="$PREV..$CUR"; else RANGE="HEAD~1..HEAD"; fi; if git -C "$DIR" diff --name-only "$RANGE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^articles/"; then sleep 60 && git -C "$DIR" pull --rebase origin main 2>&1 | tail -20; else echo "articles/ の変更なし。Qiita同期 pull をスキップ"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: push後のQiita同期を待機して pull --rebase（articles/変更時のみ）...
